notes.subject: Beliyal
notes.rationale: בליעל: kelen-kelen tɔgɔ 'Beliyal' walima a kɔrɔ 'bɛɛ-ɲɛfɔni' (bayɛlɛmabali) — KJV/JPS tɔgɔ ta, YLT/BSB kɔrɔ ta.

notes.subject: ji-bonw
notes.rationale: משברי: 'kɔgɔji ji-bonw' (breakers) walima 'kɔgɔtigiw ka fɛnw' — bagen dɔgɔya la, 'ji-bonw' de ta.

notes.subject: (bɛɛ-ɲɛfɔni)
notes.rationale: ɲɛfɔli-faralen ( ) kɔnɔ min bɔ Beliyal bɔko fɔlɔ la, a kɔrɔ ye 'bayɛlɛmabali' ye.

translation: Sabu sayaw ka ji-bonw ye n ɲagami, Beliyal (bɛɛ-ɲɛfɔni) baganw ka bajiw ye n lasiran.
